dimensions.assessment: Affects federal and state law enforcement agencies, NOAA, NIST, and commercial seafood supply chain entities.
dimensions.evidence: is consistent with the needs of Federal and State law enforcement agencies in combating IUU fishing and seafood fraud

dimensions.assessment: Provides law enforcement agencies with a new testing methodology and portable field kit for identifying seafood origin and combating illegal fishing.
dimensions.evidence: involves the use of a field kit that can be easily carried by one individual

dimensions.assessment: Directs interagency development and pilot studies without specifying specific federal funding authorizations or budget allocations.
dimensions.evidence: Key agency leadership shall jointly develop a standard methodology, based on chemical analysis, for identifying the country of origin

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific technical development, pilot studies, and reporting requirements for federal scientific and enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Under Secretary shall submit... a report

dimensions.assessment: Requires an initial development phase and report within two years, with ongoing operational applications for law enforcement.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Under Secretary shall submit... a report

missing_information: Total cost for developing the methodology, manufacturing field kits, and conducting pilot studies
importance_detail.rationale: Directs NOAA and NIST to jointly develop a standard chemical-analysis methodology and portable field kit to identify seafood country of origin, conducts pilot studies on red snapper and tuna, and requires a report to Congress.
